title: Affine pullback of a perfect generator
statement: Let g:X'\to X be an affine morphism of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let M be a perfect generator of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex, def-pc-generators, lem-pc-perfect-generator-exists]. Then Lg^*M is a generator of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X') [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-generators].

source.place: Tag 0BQT (perfect-remark-pullback-generator), affine pullback of a perfect generator

proof.text: Since M is an object of D_QCoh(X), its derived pullback Lg^*M lies in D_QCoh(X') [lem-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-qcoh], so Lg^*M is an object of the category for which the generator property is asserted. Because g is affine, the derived pullback/direct-image adjunction [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint-general] restricts to the quasi-coherent derived categories (both are full subcategories of D(O_{X'}) and D(O_X)), with natural bijections Hom(Lg^*M[n], E) = Hom(M[n], Rg_*E) for E in D_QCoh(X'). The restriction is legitimate because the affine derived equivalence [lem-sc-finite-affine-derived-equivalence] identifies Rg_* with the restriction of the quasi-coherent equivalence and hence sends D_QCoh(X') to D_QCoh(X).

source.place: Tag 0BQT, perfect-remark-pullback-generator, using the affine derived adjunction of Tag 079W

proof.text: Assume that Hom(Lg^*M[n], E)=0 for every integer n. By Step 1, Hom(M[n], Rg_*E)=0 for every n. Since M is a generator, the definition [def-pc-generators] implies Rg_*E=0: otherwise a nonzero shift of Rg_*E would admit a nonzero map from M.

The morphism g is affine, so derived direct image is conservative by [lem-sc-affine-derived-pushforward-conservative]. Applied to the morphism 0\to E, whose image Rg_*(0)\to Rg_*E=0 is an isomorphism, this gives E=0. Therefore every object E detected by all shifted Hom groups from Lg^*M is zero, which is exactly that Lg^*M is a generator of D_QCoh(X') by [def-pc-generators].
